serving.launch: Inkling-2-Mini-1x-DGX-Spark v2.9.2 (a29380b; scripts/launch.sh sha 9428eb69...) `scripts/launch.sh up` with release defaults (SPEC=dflash2, drafter incoai/Inkling-2-Mini-DFlash2@4f9088ea, MEM_FRACTION 0.88, CTX 262144, memguard 3.5 GiB) and only the swarm wiring env NAME=swarm-recipe PORT=30000 HOST=127.0.0.1 SERVED=inkling; the swarm serving default since 2026-11-25 (coding-v29-r2-v1: -20 % wall, -20 % Wh at equal quality)

execution: each screen alone on the fleet after inkling/admit.py (fresh receipt, --admission); collab_replay.py --run with four --endpoint/--host pairs (distinct physical nodes); the judge files of --judge-source must equal judge_code_sha256
credit: Blackboard architectures (Erman, Hayes-Roth, Lesser, Reddy, Hearsay-II, 1980; Nii, 1986) and multi-agent debate (Du, Li, Torralba, Tenenbaum, Mordatch, 2023); design by Fable (DESIGN-live-collab-fable.md, 2026-11-25); replay pattern of tail_replay.py and reserve_replay.py.

protocol_constants.board_prompt: collab.BOARD_PROMPT; the division-of-work rule only in arms with division_of_work true (owner decision 2026-11-26)
protocol_constants.evidence: arithmetic: the judge reason (none if the judge thinking was cut); coding: pass count and exactly one failing public case (owner decision 2026-11-26)

concurrency: <= 20 requests per node by default (--per-node, hard cap 25); one permit per agent for its life; an agent has one request in flight at a time (its gate calls included)
judge: run_variants.judge_with_reason, unchanged (main tree, read-only); the exact verifier and hidden cases only score, after the agent's last model call
note_prompt: the note prompt of a solver's first checkpoint ("Checkpoint 1 of 3") at both cuts: each replay is the stream's first checkpoint
selection:
S0_CASES primary S1 cases drawn with random.Random(S0_SEED) (their four first-wave streams cut
at 8,192 and again at 16,384: 80 checkpoints) and 20 coding streams of coding-v29-r2-v1 and coding-aot-v1-p whose
code_propose request is longer than 16K tokens and still thinking at the coding cut, grouped by recorded case: cases
with more such streams first (at most 4 streams per case, lowest agent index first), then run order, task, seed, until
20 streams (100 checkpoints in all).

checks.metric: share of checkpoints whose composed sequence starts with the recorded prompt and prefix ids and (if continued) whose continuation starts with the note call prompt + reply ids
preflight ok on every family (collab.preflight against the live template) and share of joins of finished replies (finish_reason stop) that kept exactly the template terminator
per node: 1 - prefill_compute / prompt tokens during the board phase (continuation requests only; server counters, every node must report both counters); the check uses the LOWEST node
PROXY: median over checkpoints of (note call first-token time - send time) + (continuation first-token time - send time), raw seconds, phases run at --per-node 20
share of note turns returning a parseable note or a parseable answer
checks.on_fail: fix the note prompt once, then fallback B

checks.metric: share of parsed notes with at most 256 reply tokens
checks.on_fail: fix the note prompt once, then fallback B

checks.metric: share of arithmetic note result sentences WITH at least one checkable a op b = c equation whose equations are all correct (offline regex); sentences without one are reported, not counted; no checkable sentence = not met
share of focus-line pairs of a group (same case and cut, groups of >= 2 notes) with word-set Jaccard < 0.6
share of continuations whose thinking closes within the first 512 tokens (token position of the end-of-thinking ids); needs every continuation present and >= 90 % of closes located, else not met

PROXY: mean share of a continuation's word 5-grams already in its own recorded prefix, minus the same share for the recorded continuation (recorded texts split by character share: the shim has no /detokenize)

decision_rule: PASS if every check meets its limit; otherwise the failed checks' actions apply (any "stop" action stops the idea, else fix and rerun S0). Incomplete (no decision) if any checkpoint has an infrastructure fault or the embedded plan differs from the plan file.
